title: Completeness for Prime-Dimensional Phase-Affine Circuits
summary: Equational reasoning about circuits underpins quantum-circuit optimisation and verification. The qubit CNOT-dihedral fragment achieves this through phase polynomials, layered normal forms, and a complete equational theory; we develop the corresponding theory for prime-dimensional qudits, where basis labels, value controls, and phase exponents share prime-field arithmetic. We first describe reversible affine circuits over Fd as transformations x->Ax+b, with an affine normal form extending Lafont's linear normal form by translations.
